label: Lorenzo Gusnasco da Pavia
roles: agent of Isabella d'Este in Venice
summary: Instrument maker in Venice and correspondent of Isabella d'Este, who reported seeing Leonardo and a portrait of her in March 1500.

claims.statement: Usually said to have died in 1517.

sources.cite: Wikipedia, Lorenzo da Pavia. Background only, not a ground. Seen in a web search result summary only; the page was not opened in this session.

value.text: Letter to Isabella d'Este from Venice, 13 March 1500

claims.statement: He wrote that Leonardo was in Venice and had shown him a portrait of Isabella that was very like her. The day 13 March is given in the draft; this round confirmed only 'March 1500'.
